craft_notes: CLOSING SEAL (mantra-fruit + Rudrayāmala named; etadbhyāsataḥ). Sthāyin: got-joy. Whole-pāda fusions. Close: staying. Rejected: 'Yamala literature' — killed: proper name kept.

lines: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudra-Yāmala's way;
by its rehearsal, powers and all-knowing stay.

reads_against.argmap: Thus mantra-fruit getting: this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness got.
c1_essence: Mantra-fruit got: Rudrayāmala; practice gives fruition.
